build_optical_flow_model: build a RAFT model for estimating optical flow between pairs of video frames
run_forward_optical_flow: run the RAFT forward pass to estimate optical flow between two image tensors
create_flow_initialization: create an initial flow field represented as the difference between two coordinate grids
upsample_flow_field: upsample a low-resolution flow field to full resolution using convex combination of masks
freeze_batch_norm: freeze all batch normalization layers in the RAFT model by setting them to eval mode
